exclude.reason: Deprecated; use parse_dns_zone, which returns the same zone data in a different format.

evidence.note: Flagged deprecated: true; This function is deprecated.
The pinned zone parameter is an array of zones, which WHM reads as repeated zone keys (docs/api/source-audit.md, Request contracts).
The pinned domain description documents fetching several domains by repeating the domain parameter (or by incrementing it as domain-1, domain-2); the list is sent as repeated domain keys.
getzonerecord returned record[].preference of an MX record as a decimal string, although the pinned MX schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
getzonerecord returned record[].serial of the SOA record as a decimal string, although the pinned SOA schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
getzonerecord returned record[].refresh of the SOA record as a decimal string, although the pinned SOA schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
getzonerecord returned record[].retry of the SOA record as a decimal string, although the pinned SOA schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
getzonerecord returned record[].expire of the SOA record as a decimal string, although the pinned SOA schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
The pinned domain description documents checking several domains by repeating the domain parameter (or by incrementing it as domain-1, domain-2); the list is sent as repeated domain keys.

has_local_authority returned records[].error as an explicit null when the authority check succeeded, although the pinned schema declares a string returned only on failure; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice

is_alias_available returned resolver as an explicit null when no PowerDNS resolver setting exists, although the pinned schema declares a string; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
listmxs returned record[].preference as a decimal string, although the pinned schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice

notes.text: Returns ipv6 as an empty string, rather than omitting it, when the nameserver has no IPv6 address.

evidence.note: lookupnsips returned ipv6 as an empty string for a nameserver without an IPv6 address, although the pinned description says the field is returned only when an IPv6 address exists; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
